Subject: the bar's rhinestone/gem mosaic sign reading STUD / LOVE / WELCOME HOME — a piece of artwork rather than a room shot, which makes it venue-specific, instantly distinctive at thumbnail size on the board, and free of the two risks the other candidates carried (no identifiable faces, no third-party photographer watermark). statusHistory.note: San Francisco Tier 1 queue (content/post-plan.md), war-room slate 2026-08-31. Drafted via near-write-article. Trust 'auto': operator directly commissioned this pin in chat, and the slate was war-room-verified. VERIFY-STILL-OPEN: operator raised a closure concern mid-draft; checked and REFUTED. The Stud is open at 1123 Folsom St. Evidence: (1) the venue's own calendar is actively programming through May 2027 (Slaughter Haus 10-11 Oct 2026, Queer Nonprofit Happy Hour monthly on second Tuesdays, Nudie Nubie Show SF 8 May 2027, TRUCK weekly Weds 9:30pm, PUMPS drag Fridays); (2) it was covered as an operating business by Mission Local, SFist, the SF Chronicle and SF Bay Times through July 2026 during the Meta/Instagram suspension story; (3) SF Heritage's Legacy Business profile lists it at the current address. SOURCE OF THE FALSE CLOSURE SIGNAL, now the subject of a correction section in the body: two Yelp listings exist — 'the-stud-san-francisco' (399 9th St, genuinely closed, but stamped 'Updated September 2026' which reads as a fresh closure) and 'the-stud-san-francisco-2' (1123 Folsom, operating, updated July 2026). Separately, studsf.com/closed is the spring-2020 announcement about the 9th & Harrison site and carries NO visible date on the page, so it surfaces looking current. This is the same trap the war-room slate already flagged on the image side (Commons photos show the old 9th St building). DROPPED FROM THE PIECE on legal grounds: the slate's proposed 'Stud Alley arrests' angle. Stud Alley is an unpermitted Pride-weekend block party at Kissling & 11th (SFPD arrested 20 on 27 June 2026; the DA charged 18 with misdemeanour unlawful assembly, failure to disperse, and resisting/obstructing). No source found connects the BAR to organising it, and no statement from the collective appears in any coverage; sources describe the party as involving graffiti and vandalism, so attributing it to the venue would be defamation-adjacent on zero sourcing. Excluded rather than hedged. FACT RECONCILED: co-op member count — Wikipedia says 15 at the 30 Dec 2016 takeover, SF Heritage says seventeen currently; used SF Heritage's figure and attributed it as current. HERO IMAGE: RESOLVED at tier 1 (real source photo), not the tier-3 illustration originally planned. Operator supplied five images from the venue's own Squarespace CDN on 2026-09-02, which also produced the new always-check-the-official-website directive in near-illustrator — the illustration prompts written earlier were discarded as a tier-3 fallback that was never needed. All five were downloaded and visually inspected before use, per the do-not-publish-what-you-have-not-seen rule. CHOSE: 'low res gem stud sign' — the rhinestone/gem mosaic reading STUD / LOVE / WELCOME HOME. Artwork rather than a room shot, so it is venue-specific and distinctive at thumbnail size while carrying no faces and no third-party watermark. IN-BODY: 'NYE Adjusted 019', the former Harrison Street entrance at night, placed inside the correction section and explicitly captioned as the OLD room — the real-photo version of the then/now diptych originally specced, doing the same argumentative work. REJECTED, with reasons: (1) 'IMG_8826' (seven staff behind the bar) — carries a visible third-party photographer watermark, 'Desperate Living / Shot In The City Photography', so the copyright is the photographer's and not the venue's; also seven identifiable faces at a queer venue (the canto-dos-ursos consent precedent), explicit slogan text on a shirt, and it depicts the old bar. (2) the 1980s 'STUD'S UNITED' Pride-parade photo — historically excellent but only 763x549, too small for a 2500w hero, and its provenance/copyright is unknown. (3) 'STUDLOGO WITH 2026' — a flat black-and-white wordmark, poor as a board thumbnail; its VALUE was factual rather than visual and was taken into the copy instead: it revealed that 2026 is the bar's 60th anniversary year ('Celebrating 60 years of queer revelry. 1966 - 2026 (and beyond)'), now a bullet and a closing beat in the body. INFRASTRUCTURE BUILT THIS SESSION: components/mdx/Figure.tsx, because mdxComponents mapped only NearLink and there was no way to render an in-body image at all — the always-consult-on-mid-post-images directive had no rendering path until now. LOCALES: not yet written — full-locale-coverage does not require localizing a draft, so the six locales are pending the hero decision and the status flip. Coordinates are a manual approximation for 1123 Folsom St between 7th and 8th (confidence 0.6, meets the gate) and should be refined before publish.

Flipped to active after all six locales were written and every quality-gate-before-publish condition was checked explicitly rather than assumed. Gates: shortTitle <=48, tagline <=90, seoDescription <=320, >=3 bullets, >=1 in-text external link to a URL in meta.sources, >=1 <NearLink>, and the opener bans (no crowd-consensus first word, no faux-candor framing) verified in ALL SIX locales, not just English. Body length: en 643 words, pt-BR 520, es-ES 542, es-419 527, it 493. zh-CN measured 784 CJK characters (~490 word-equivalents) — a naive whitespace word count returns 69 and FALSE-FAILS the 150-word floor, because Chinese does not delimit words with spaces. Worth knowing for any future automated gate. Locales are genuine local editions per each near-translator persona, not literal translations: es-419 adds practical arrival/payment notes for a traveller from the region and es-ES does not (Spain-specific vocabulary, no LatAm constructions); zh-CN adds card-acceptance, ride-hailing and navigate-by-address guidance for a mainland traveller, and specifically warns that searching the venue NAME surfaces the old address — the locale where the false-closure trap bites hardest; pt-BR and it run tighter than the English source, which each persona is entitled to do. Internal links: stray-dog-mission-san-francisco and ocean-beach-cafe-san-francisco in every locale, both genuine SF connections rather than forced. In-body Figure renders in all six via the new components/mdx/Figure.tsx.
